title: Senior Research Fellow
bio: Chris Dede designs learning environments based on emerging technologies, such as virtual worlds and augmented realities, studying their implications for practice, leadership, and policy. He also conducts research on scaling up educational improvements, motivation, and professional development.
research_interests: With deep expertise that connects research
